summary.intent: Review the current state of the android-keyboard project (uncommitted GPU/QNN work, untracked docs, submodule state) and then push everything to GitHub, including a second/additional repository the user referred to.
summary.outcome: The tree was reviewed in depth, verified to build via the distrobox android-dbx build script, two small cleanups were made (.gitignore for .pi/, orphaned KDoc in ImportResourceActivity.kt), and all work was committed as a single 'Voice input: per-language backend picker + QNN/Vulkan hardening' commit. The actual push to GitHub (and identification of the additional repo) was not completed before the transcript ended.

repo: Main repo is /home/gc/android-keyboard on branch master, with side branches GPUEnablement and PartialTranscription.
The `libs` submodule tracks oozut/android-libs (pinned commit f71fba92) and supplies the ONNX Runtime QNN and QNN runtime AARs.
ResourceHelper.resolveVoiceInputSelection() is the single source of truth for model+backend selection, replacing the old boolean hardware-acceleration switch.
QNN routing is driven by ModelLoader.requiredBackend rather than special-casing ModelQnnFileFile.
QnnSupport uses an allow-list of Snapdragon chipsets (HTP version + SOC_MODEL) rather than a blanket Qualcomm check.
.pi/ is a local agent scratch directory (build.log, launch.log, extensions) that should not be committed; .entire/ holds session checkpoints/metadata used for local context recovery.
Untracked docs (BUILDING.md, DEPLOYMENT.md, GPU_REVIEW_RECOMMENDATIONS.md, PARTIAL_TRANSCRIPTION_PLAN.md) and GPU_QNN_INTEGRATION.md changes were part of the pending work.
Builds run through `distrobox enter android-dbx -- bash .pi/build-debug.sh`; the host is not the build environment.

code.finding: New file implementing Snapdragon chipset allow-list (HTP version + SOC_MODEL) and a Vulkan gate mirroring ggml-vulkan requirements; no longer blacklists Mali.
Defines the Backend enum (CPU/Vulkan/QNN) and availability/unavailableReason logic used by both the settings UI and the voice input action.
Switched to ConcurrentHashMap + computeIfAbsent so parallel preloads of models are safe.
Tokenizes the personal-dictionary glossary into the decoder prompt, restricted to content tokens (id < EOT) to avoid the endoftext-first-token failure.
Introduced a process-global ggml log router with a live-state registry, fixing a use-after-free after close() and a leaked decoder output on failure; JNI local refs are now released.
Filterbank initialization is now serialized to avoid concurrent-init races.
Non-QNN-ZIP import failures now show a generic error message; an orphaned KDoc was cleaned up during review.
Reworked to expose the per-language CPU/Vulkan/QNN backend picker instead of the old hw-accel toggle, with strings like voice_input_backend_* and QNN unavailability messaging.
Updated to ignore the local .pi/ agent scratch directory.

workflow: Start a review by inspecting `git status --short`, `git branch -vv`, `git remote -v`, `git log --oneline`, and `git submodule status` together to see uncommitted, untracked, and submodule drift at once.
Run a secret scan (grep for api_key/token/secret/PRIVATE KEY) over new/modified docs before staging.
Verify `git check-ignore` on scratch dirs (.pi, .entire) before `git add -A` to avoid committing local agent state.
Rebuild after late source edits before committing; the distrobox build script is the authoritative check.
Sandbox proxy env vars break gh/network calls; prefix with `env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u http_proxy`.
When memory recall fails, local session checkpoints under .entire/ and .pi/agent/sessions can substitute for prior context.
